instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide full-body shot from a slightly high angle. In a motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right. She leans forward, extending her left arm to touch the chest of the bearded man in a black cap and dark polo shirt (R1), who stands on the right facing her. The scene is evenly lit by overhead lights, highlighting the simple studio interior.

R2 initiates the arm-to-chest contact rather than R1
